Easter Sunday can fall on any date from 22 March to 25 April inclusive. How many possible dates is that?
why: 22–31 March is 10 dates and 1–25 April is 25 more: 10 + 25 = 35.

text: A simnel cake has one marzipan ball for each apostle except Judas. If it has 11 balls, how many apostles were there?
Lent is 40 days plus six Sundays. If Ash Wednesday is 1 March, on what date is Easter Sunday?
why: 40 + 6 = 46 days after Ash Wednesday: 1 March plus 46 days is 16 April.

text: Which word goes before CROSS, DOG and POT to make three new words?

text: The clocks go forward from 1am to 2am. If you sleep from 11pm to 7am by the clock, how long have you actually slept?
why: 11pm to 7am shows 8 hours, but the hour from 1am to 2am never happens: 7 hours.
